_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. aggroRadius 1.0 is the pre-merge zone radius verbatim and IS the interaction range (D7 ⇒ interaction.range omitted). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches the base Damage aura and Recall — the closest thing the world has to a starting trainer.
name: TownCrier

lines: The city must hear of those wolves. Head east and report to the militia.

options.blockedLine: Those wolves are a pest, get rid of them!

grants.line: You're finally here! We need your help! Wolves prowl the forrests, kill them!
The city needs to hear of these wolf attacks! Take this so you can find your way back.
